name: digest-staleness
description: A digest note records the files it was written from (sources: path and sha256). When a listed file changes after the digest, SessionStart lines, prompt hits, file hints and ask results say STALE with the path, review lists it, and editing the files asks about their digests at Stop (several in one sentence); a digest of an unchanged file is never flagged, and confirming the stale one (the author checked the file) clears the flag everywhere.
